title: Drama Heats Up on 'Selling Sunset' As Bre Tiesi Brings Shocking Accusations to Chelsea Lazkani<gwmw style="display:none;"></gwmw>
htmlContent:
Bre Tiesi's revelation of unsettling news to Chelsea Lazkani about her husband, Jeff Lazkani, intensifies the real estate drama on 'Selling Sunset.' In a new clip released by Netflix on Wednesday, Tiesi tells Chelsea that her husband was allegedly seen making out with another woman.

Tiesi starts the conversation by narrating an incident she heard from her friend Amanda, whom she has known for several years. Tiesi, who has known Amanda for a couple of years, asked Amanda to go to lunch while sitting with Chelsea at a bar.

She told me that her friend, who she’s still very close with and sees, lives at the W Hotel in Hollywood and that he saw your husband with some girl.”

Tiesi continues, explaining that Amanda provided receipts during their lunch, implying that the story had some hard evidence behind it. When Chelsea inquires about the evidence, Tiesi reveals that Amanda's friend witnessed Jeff and the woman making out in the hotel lobby. Tiesi adds that the friend had seen them together multiple times.

Chelsea, appearing shocked, asks Tiesi if she trusts Amanda's information, to which Tiesi replies, “Yes, I do … I can’t say she’s like, my best friend.”

Despite the tension between the two women in the past, Tiesi tells Chelsea that she wanted to approach her "woman to woman" with the information, noting that she has been in a similar situation.

“I was married, my husband was doing the same thing with multiple women,” Tiesi said “I know you don’t necessarily care for me, but I wouldn’t wish this on you or anyone ever. Like, I’ve seriously been there, and it’s awful. But regardless, it was brought up, she said it, and I feel like you have the right to know.”

Chelsea takes a sip of red wine at the end of the clip, which leaves viewers wondering how she will respond to this bombshell.

Fans will be able to see this scene quickly, but real-life events have already taken a drastic turn. After being married for more than six years, Chelsea filed for divorce from Jeff in March. The real estate agent asked for spousal support, legal expenses, and physical and legal custody of their two children, son Maddox, 5, and daughter Melia, 3.

Jeff made the accusations shortly after that, asserting that Chelsea had been "physically violent and aggressive" during their marriage. He claimed that he was hit in the face by her a year ago, breaking his glasses and causing a small cut. Jeff stated in court documents that they had been sleeping in separate bedrooms since their son, Maddox, was born. He further alleged that Chelsea took some of his belongings from their Manhattan Beach home after filing for divorce.

The couple, who wed in 2017, has been engulfed in controversy as the details of their split continue to surface. Chelsea, who joined the "Selling Sunset" cast in Season 5 in 2022, has also had her fair share of conflict with Tiesi. Tiesi's unconventional relationship with Nick Cannon, with whom she shares her son Legendary, born in July 2022, has led to a clash.

Season 8 of Selling Sunset will debut on Netflix in September. The glamorous realtors are set to cause even more drama to unfold for fans. As tensions rise and personal lives unravel, the show promises a new explosive season filled with high-stakes deals and even more high-stakes relationships.
